race.comment: SALARAE (12) may have been unsuited by a wet track and leading last time out when folding up quickly at Kyneton nearly 4 weeks ago. She has been given the all clear at a trial since then, and dropping back to 1200m will help her. Hard to beat in this modest field. NINETYFIVEINAFIFTY (10) won a pair of jump-outs prior to finishing fourth by less than a length here 15 days ago. She will improve off that stout effort, and in this company, she can take it out. Stick with her. BAMBU BABE (8) has been in form at the picnic meetings to start her career in NSW, but this is not much harder, and from a good gate, she can be competitive again. MISS VERONA (14) battled on well enough fresh up at Bendigo, and strips fitter for this easier assignment. Keep safe from a good draw in this.
